tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H <= 0.48, while the forecast horizon is 23.9. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the long-timescale ambiguity and tests the predicted reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not adequately identify the slow component at the target horizon.
Fine short-trajectory measurements are less directly informative about the long-horizon reversal.
The initial rows have zero s_grad and cannot identify its sink dependence.
